name: 1.23.0-beta.8
notes: Ren'Py games: mods. A game's page has a Mods section where each mod can be switched on or off before playing; Play says which are on. Add a mod as a folder, files or a ZIP, or drop it on the game's page. Mods are kept encrypted like the game.
When adding a game, .rpa archives that look like mods (by their name, or because their date is far from the game's own files) are listed, with a switch to keep each one as a mod you can switch off.
Games added before: “Turn files into a mod” lets you pick files or folders of the game folder to make them a mod; archives that look like mods are ticked already.
